hook.name: QuotronFloorHook
hook.description: Fee engine for QUOTRON floor pools that overrides LP fees to zero and charges a tiered fee on the stock side via return deltas. During a 6-hour launch window, whitelisted swappers pay 3%; holders of the 100 FCFS reduced-fee spots pay 10%; all others pay 40%. After the window, everyone pays 3%. Each fee is split four ways: ~2/3 to a reflections engine, ~1/6 to a STONKBROKER buy-and-burn pot, ~1/6 to an LP-reinvest pot, and ~5% to a creator address paid directly per swap.
